name: content-strategy
displayName: Blog Content Strategy, Content Calendar & Content Audit
description: Decide what your team should publish next: plan blog topics and content marketing priorities around your goals and company evidence, and turn your backlog into a weekly editorial calendar that fits your writers' hours, for your own team or your agency's clients. From your existing article list, recommend which old articles to update, merge or retire; turn a chosen topic and research findings you provide into a writer's brief, and plan lead magnets for your topic clusters. It plans; it does not write the content or build campaigns. Network use: when you give a sitemap URL, the content audit reads it and up to 10 public pages you name on that site; separately, because its advice draws on dated Google guidance positions it bundles, it may offer to check the most recent dated copy on the author's page, https://black-vector.com/content-strategy/myths, and fetches that page only after you say yes.
